imagens.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: visual development keyframe for the original mobile fighting game K.O, production reference, not an actual gameplay screenshot.
Create a polished widescreen 16:9 3D stylized fighting-game concept image, sophisticated hand-painted materials, strong sculpted shapes, expressive faces and restrained ink-like contours. Side-on combat camera, both fighters shown full body, separated with clear silhouettes. Left: Pipoca, original athletic female anthropomorphic white rabbit boxer, long upright ears with pink interiors, bright expressive eyes, short sporty blue boxing shorts with white waistband, red leather boxing gloves and light athletic ankle wraps, springy confident boxing guard. Fur has subtle tactile detail, powerful legs, friendly determined personality, no sexualization. Right: Uivo, original tall athletic anthropomorphic gray wolf martial artist, erect pointed ears, lighter muzzle and chest, amber eyes, indigo sleeveless martial-arts vest and loose dark indigo trousers, cream hand wraps, bare paw-like feet, confident fierce but friendly fighting stance; visible tail. Keep animal identities unmistakable, not humans wearing masks.
Arena: original Brazilian rooftop training ring at night, wet concrete floor with elegant soft reflections, chain-link railings far behind the fighting plane, warm windows of a layered city skyline, distant violet hills, small amber utility lamps, subtle atmospheric depth. No ring ropes obscuring fighters, no crowds in foreground.
Lighting: warm amber key light and cool violet rim light, readable eyes, grounded contact shadows, cinematic color contrast but clear midtones. Composition: camera at torso height, no extreme wide-angle distortion, generous space between fighters for readable attacks, clean foreground floor, horizon around upper third, action ready to begin. Original visual identity in violet, gold, blue and red. High-end game art, believable anatomy and cloth folds, not plastic figurines, not low-poly block models, not photorealistic horror. No text, logos, HUD, buttons, watermark, blood or gore. This is a visual target for future rigged 3D assets.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: character production reference turnaround sheet.
Input image 1 is CHARACTER IDENTITY REFERENCE ONLY. Create a NEW clean professional 3D character turnaround sheet of ONLY Pipoca, the white rabbit boxer on the left of the reference. Preserve her precise face design, white fur, pink inner ears, long upright ears, red boxing gloves, blue athletic top and blue boxing shorts with white waistband, ankle wraps and rabbit feet, small white tail. Original athletic female rabbit character, friendly determined expression, age adult, no sexualization.
Wide landscape board, three equal full-body orthographic views left-to-right FRONT, RIGHT SIDE, BACK, all at the exact same scale with feet on the same baseline and ears fully visible. Relaxed neutral A-pose suitable for modeling and rigging, hands/gloves away from hips, no combat action, no perspective distortion. In side view the face silhouette, muzzle, ear profile and foot anatomy must be clear. In rear view show tail and clothing construction. Same outfit and anatomy consistently in all three views, two arms two legs, no spare limbs, no other character. Stylized high-end 3D game rendering with sculpted fur clumps, hand-painted material accents, red leather glove stitching and subtle blue fabric, readable at game scale. Flat light warm-gray studio background, gentle neutral lighting that reveals form, soft ground shadow; no dramatic arena lights.
Optional small isolated close-up of face may sit in an otherwise free top-right corner ONLY if it does not interfere with the three full-body views. No text, no labels, no logos, no watermark. This is a model reference image, not a real mesh or animation.
